mutants.rationale: Claim restriction never raises Phi1 although the sub-window weights were raised from 2 to 3 (hypothesis "restricted weights" dropped): Phi1 goes from 4 to 6.
Claim that filling the triangle with a 2-cell repairs the residual; Phi1 depends only on (C0, C1, d0, J, h) and stays 1.
Claim attaching a 2-cell cannot change Gamma2; the new face has d1 h = 1, so Gamma2 rises from 0 to 1 and the class moves from ClosedResidual to ActiveClosureFailure.
Accept a "face" row (1,0,0) as a 2-cell although d1 d0 != 0; the enlarged data is not a window.
Read the sum of kept edge residuals (the source list sum) as Phi1 of the sub-window; the minimum over potentials is 2.
Say growth does not change the diagnostic class because Phi1 is unchanged; the filled square is ActiveClosureFailure.
Count an edit of h by a coboundary as lowering Phi1; Phi1 is a class function and stays 2.
Claim changing the declared weights leaves Phi1 alone; down-weighting from 3 to 1 lowers it from 6 to 2.
Report Gamma2 = 1 for the invalid-row window as if it were the source Gamma2 at the minimal residual; non-closed windows have non-unique minimal residuals and no class value.
Claim a restriction with lowered weights (2 to 1) raised Phi1 to 6; with weights not raised the monotonicity theorem applies and Phi1 is 2.
Claim deleting five of six K4 edges leaves Phi1 = 3; the surviving edge is exact, so Phi1 falls to 0.
Put the routing/status name NoRule into the diagnostic-class field; the classes are ExactClass, ClosedResidual, ActiveClosureFailure, and a non-window is marked NotAWindow.
Claim a restriction of K4 to three edges raised Phi1 from 3 to 4 although the weights and cochain are the restrictions.
Carry the zero potential and zero dual vector as the witness for the whole K4 window; both are feasible but their common value 0 is not Phi1 = 3.
Keep all four K4 faces after deleting edges; a 2-cell survives restriction only when its whole support does.
